dk_dst_pskat.dataset: PSKAT Local government personal taxation (KOM municipal tax, KIRKE church tax, GRUND land tax)
dk_dst_pskat.notes: Church tax applies only to members of the Folkekirke; kept as separate field. Land tax in per mille. Christianso (411) not a tax municipality - no value.

dk_dst_indkp101.dataset: INDKP101 Income for people by region, unit (116 = average income for all people), sex (MOK), type of income (100 disposable, 290 taxable)
dk_dst_indkp101.notes: 2025 disposable income returned 0 for every area (not yet published) and was rejected; 2024 used. Mean, not median.

dk_dst_aup01.dataset: AUP01 Unemployment in per cent of the labour force (provisional), ALDER=TOT, KOEN=TOT
dk_dst_aup01.notes: Monthly, provisional, not seasonally adjusted (no annual municipal rate table found).

dk_dst_hisbk.dataset: HISBK Life expectancy for new born babies by municipality, sex, 5-year period
dk_dst_hisbk.notes: '..' (suppressed) for 5 small island municipalities: 411 Christianso, 492 Aero, 563 Fano, 741 Samso, 825 Laeso.

dk_dst_straf11.dataset: STRAF11 Reported criminal offences by region, type of offence (1 = criminal code total), quarter
dk_dst_straf11.notes: Sum of last 4 quarters. About 10% of national offences are coded 998 (unknown municipality) and are not allocated, so municipal rates are lower bounds. Christianso excluded (pop 92).

dk_dst_folk1a.dataset: FOLK1A Population at the first day of the quarter (all other dims eliminated)
dk_dst_folk1a.notes: Denominator for the per-1,000 crime rate only.

no_ssb_06944.dataset: 06944 Household income by type of household; InntSkatt = median income after tax, HusholdType 0000 all households
no_ssb_06944.notes: Excludes student households. National value 676,100 equals the figure on ssb.no statistic page. Values only for the 357 current (2024) municipalities; superseded codes in NO.json get none.

no_ssb_08487.dataset: 08487 Offences reported to the police by scene of crime (municipality); LovbruddKrim 1AAAAA-9ZZZZz all groups; AnmLovbrPer1000
no_ssb_08487.notes: Two-year average per year. The '0-999 Total' code is all '.' in this table; 'All groups of offences' used. Brief's 08484 is national only. Utsira (1151) suppressed.

no_ssb_06035.dataset: 06035 Freeholder dwellings, average price per m2 and number of sales (closed series 2002-2024), Boligtype 01 detached houses
no_ssb_06035.notes: Price suppressed ('..') where fewer than ~10 sales; closed series, 2024 is the last year.
